items.t: General Electric (GE) Reshapes Key Aerospace Supplier With New 50 50 Venture
items.sum: General Electric (NYSE:GE) has agreed to a new 50/50 joint venture structure for Montana Precision Products with Doncasters. Doncasters is acquiring a 50% stake in Montana Precision Products from an affiliate of GE Aerospace, creating shared ownership of the supplier.
